package com.purewo.cyberstream

import android.content.Intent
import android.os.SystemClock
import androidx.media3.common.Player
import androidx.media3.ui.PlayerView
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference

/** Exercises the real Media3 Activity against a public HLS fixture. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class PlayerActivitySmokeTest {
    @Test
    fun opensAStandardHlsStreamWithItsProtocolHint() {
        val session = JSONObject()
            .put("sessionId", "android-test-${System.nanoTime()}")
            .put("initialResourceId", "public-hls")
            .put("startTimeMs", 0L)
            .put("movie", JSONObject().put("id", "test").put("title", "Media3 smoke test"))
            .put(
                "resources",
                JSONArray().put(
                    JSONObject()
                        .put("id", "public-hls")
                        .put("title", "Public HLS")
                        .put(
                            "direct",
                            JSONObject()
                                .put("id", "direct")
                                .put("label", "Original")
                                .put("mimeType", "application/x-mpegURL")
                                .put(
                                    "url",
                                    "https://storage.googleapis.com/shaka-demo-assets/angel-one-hls/hls.m3u8",
                                ),
                        )
                        .put("subtitles", JSONArray()),
                ),
            )

        val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
        val targetContext = instrumentation.targetContext
        val activity = instrumentation.startActivitySync(
            Intent(targetContext, PlayerActivity::class.java)
                .putExtra(PlayerActivity.EXTRA_SESSION_JSON, session.toString()),
        ) as PlayerActivity

        try {
            val state = AtomicInteger(Player.STATE_IDLE)
            val error = AtomicReference<Throwable?>(null)
            val deadline = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 20_000L

            while (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < deadline) {
                instrumentation.runOnMainSync {
                    val playerView = activity.findViewById<PlayerView>(R.id.media_player_view)
                    val player = playerView.player
                    state.set(player?.playbackState ?: Player.STATE_IDLE)
                    error.set(player?.playerError)
                }
                if (state.get() == Player.STATE_READY || error.get() != null) break
                Thread.sleep(250L)
            }

            assertNull("Media3 failed to prepare the HLS fixture: ${error.get()}", error.get())
            assertEquals("Media3 never reached READY for the HLS fixture", Player.STATE_READY, state.get())
        } finally {
            instrumentation.runOnMainSync { activity.finish() }
            instrumentation.waitForIdleSync()
        }
    }
}

content:
# Media3 FFmpeg audio extension

CyberStream Android uses the official AndroidX Media3 FFmpeg decoder module as
a local audio fallback. Platform `MediaCodec` renderers remain first in the
renderer list; FFmpeg is selected only when Android cannot decode an audio
track itself.

## Pinned sources

- AndroidX Media tag: `1.10.1`
- AndroidX source: `https://github.com/androidx/media/tree/1.10.1/libraries/decoder_ffmpeg`
- FFmpeg release: `6.0.1`
- FFmpeg archive: `https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-6.0.1.tar.xz`
- FFmpeg archive SHA-256: `9B16B8731D78E596B4BE0D720428CA42DF642BB2D78342881FF7F5BC29FC9623`
- Android NDK used for FFmpeg static libraries: `26.1.10909125` (r26b)
- Android ABI level: `24`

The Media3 Gradle build selected NDK `27.0.12077973` to compile the small JNI
wrapper around the already-built FFmpeg static libraries. The resulting AAR is
compatible with the app's `minSdk 24` and contains all four standard ABIs.

## Enabled FFmpeg decoders

`aac ac3 eac3 dca truehd flac opus vorbis mp3 alac`

`dca` covers DTS and DTS-HD. `truehd` covers Dolby TrueHD. No encoder, muxer,
network protocol, GPL component, or non-free component is enabled.

The FFmpeg configure result reports `License: LGPL version 2.1 or later`.

## Build command

From an AndroidX Media `1.10.1` checkout, with FFmpeg 6.0.1 extracted at
`libraries/decoder_ffmpeg/src/main/jni/ffmpeg`:

```bash
FFMPEG_MODULE_PATH="$PWD/libraries/decoder_ffmpeg/src/main"
"$FFMPEG_MODULE_PATH/jni/build_ffmpeg.sh" \
  "$FFMPEG_MODULE_PATH" \
  "$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/ndk/26.1.10909125" \
  linux-x86_64 \
  24 \
  aac ac3 eac3 dca truehd flac opus vorbis mp3 alac

./gradlew :lib-decoder-ffmpeg:assembleRelease
```

Copy `lib-decoder-ffmpeg-release.aar` to:

`app/libs/media3-decoder-ffmpeg-1.10.1-ffmpeg6.0.1.aar`

Current AAR SHA-256:

`8721422B552D0BEAE9222B265B6BE580EC2C6215493602D51195E361C8719916`

## Runtime policy

- `DefaultRenderersFactory.EXTENSION_RENDERER_MODE_ON`: Android system decoder
  first, FFmpeg only as fallback.
- Float PCM output is enabled when the device's `AudioTrack` supports it.
- No loudness normalization, lossy re-encoding, or intentional sample-rate
  conversion is configured.
- Multichannel audio is downmixed only when the Android output path cannot
  accept the source channel layout.
- This extension is local decoding only. It never invokes a server transcode.

## Distribution obligations

The APK includes the FFmpeg LGPL 2.1 license and a third-party notice under
`app/src/main/assets`. FFmpeg is statically linked into `libffmpegJNI.so`, so a
public production release must also satisfy LGPL 2.1 section 6, including a
practical relinking/source path for the exact FFmpeg build. Keep this build
recipe and the corresponding source archive with each release artifact.

package com.purewo.cyberstream

import androidx.media3.common.MimeTypes
import androidx.media3.common.util.UnstableApi
import androidx.media3.decoder.ffmpeg.FfmpegLibrary
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

/** Verifies the packaged native library and every explicitly enabled decoder. */
@UnstableApi
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class FfmpegExtensionSmokeTest {
    @Test
    fun packagedFfmpegLibraryExposesAllRequiredAudioDecoders() {
        assertTrue("FFmpeg JNI library must load on this device ABI", FfmpegLibrary.isAvailable())
        assertEquals("6.0.1", FfmpegLibrary.getVersion())

        val requiredFormats = linkedMapOf(
            "AAC" to MimeTypes.AUDIO_AAC,
            "AC-3" to MimeTypes.AUDIO_AC3,
            "E-AC-3" to MimeTypes.AUDIO_E_AC3,
            "E-AC-3 JOC" to MimeTypes.AUDIO_E_AC3_JOC,
            "DTS" to MimeTypes.AUDIO_DTS,
            "DTS-HD" to MimeTypes.AUDIO_DTS_HD,
            "TrueHD" to MimeTypes.AUDIO_TRUEHD,
            "FLAC" to MimeTypes.AUDIO_FLAC,
            "Opus" to MimeTypes.AUDIO_OPUS,
            "Vorbis" to MimeTypes.AUDIO_VORBIS,
        )
        requiredFormats.forEach { (label, mimeType) ->
            assertTrue("FFmpeg build is missing the $label decoder", FfmpegLibrary.supportsFormat(mimeType))
        }
    }
}

/** Plays real encoded fixtures and verifies the decoder that Media3 initialized. */
@UnstableApi
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class AudioFormatPlaybackTest {
    private data class Fixture(
        val label: String,
        val file: String,
        val mustUseFfmpeg: Boolean = false,
        val mustUsePlatformDecoder: Boolean = false,
    )

    @Test
    fun playsRequiredAudioFormatsAndInitializesExpectedDecoders() {
        val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
        val baseUrl = InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments().getString("fixtureBaseUrl")?.trimEnd('/')
        assumeTrue("Pass -e fixtureBaseUrl to run local codec playback tests", !baseUrl.isNullOrBlank())

        val fixtures = listOf(
            Fixture("AAC", "aac.m4a", mustUsePlatformDecoder = true),
            Fixture("AC-3", "ac3.mka"),
            Fixture("E-AC-3", "eac3.mka"),
            Fixture("E-AC-3 JOC", "eac3-joc.mka"),
            Fixture("DTS", "dts.mkv", mustUseFfmpeg = true),
            Fixture("DTS-HD MA", "dts-hd-ma.mkv", mustUseFfmpeg = true),
            Fixture("DTS:X", "dts-x.mkv", mustUseFfmpeg = true),
            Fixture("Dolby TrueHD 7.1", "truehd-7.1.mka", mustUseFfmpeg = true),
            Fixture("FLAC 24-bit", "flac-24bit.mka"),
            Fixture("Opus 5.1", "opus-5.1.mka"),
            Fixture("Vorbis", "vorbis.mkv"),
        )

        fixtures.forEachIndexed { index, fixture ->
            val session = JSONObject()
                .put("sessionId", "codec-${index}-${System.nanoTime()}")
                .put("initialResourceId", fixture.file)
                .put("startTimeMs", 0L)
                .put("movie", JSONObject().put("id", "codec-test").put("title", fixture.label))
                .put(
                    "resources",
                    JSONArray().put(
                        JSONObject()
                            .put("id", fixture.file)
                            .put("title", fixture.label)
                            .put(
                                "direct",
                                JSONObject()
                                    .put("id", "direct")
                                    .put("label", "Original")
                                    .put("url", "$baseUrl/${fixture.file}"),
                            )
                            .put("subtitles", JSONArray()),
                    ),
                )

            val activity = instrumentation.startActivitySync(
                Intent(instrumentation.targetContext, PlayerActivity::class.java)
                    .putExtra(PlayerActivity.EXTRA_SESSION_JSON, session.toString())
                    .addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK),
            ) as PlayerActivity

            try {
                var decoderName: String? = null
                var playbackError: String? = null
                var playbackState = Player.STATE_IDLE
                val deadline = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 15_000L
                while (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < deadline) {
                    instrumentation.runOnMainSync {
                        decoderName = activity.audioDecoderNameForTesting()
                        playbackError = activity.lastPlaybackErrorForTesting()
                        playbackState = activity.findViewById<PlayerView>(R.id.media_player_view)
                            .player
                            ?.playbackState
                            ?: Player.STATE_IDLE
                    }
                    if (playbackError != null || (decoderName != null && playbackState != Player.STATE_IDLE)) break
                    Thread.sleep(100L)
                }

                assertNull("${fixture.label} playback failed: $playbackError", playbackError)
                assertNotNull("${fixture.label} never initialized an audio decoder", decoderName)
                if (fixture.mustUseFfmpeg) {
                    assertTrue(
                        "${fixture.label} should use FFmpeg fallback, got $decoderName",
                        decoderName!!.startsWith("ffmpeg"),
                    )
                }
                if (fixture.mustUsePlatformDecoder) {
                    assertFalse(
                        "${fixture.label} should keep the platform decoder ahead of FFmpeg, got $decoderName",
                        decoderName!!.startsWith("ffmpeg"),
                    )
                }
                assertNotNull("${fixture.label} did not expose an input MIME type", activity.audioMimeTypeForTesting())
            } finally {
                instrumentation.runOnMainSync { activity.finish() }
                instrumentation.waitForIdleSync()
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.purewo.cyberstream

import android.app.Activity
import android.content.Intent
import android.os.Bundle
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject

/** Temporary debug-only launcher used for emulator visual verification. */
class PlayerPreviewActivity : Activity() {
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        val resources = JSONArray()
        for (episode in 1..3) {
            resources.put(
                JSONObject()
                    .put("id", "preview-$episode")
                    .put("title", "Altered Carbon · Episode $episode · 2160p HDR")
                    .put("episode", episode.toString())
                    .put("season", 1)
                    .put(
                        "direct",
                        JSONObject()
                            .put("id", "direct")
                            .put("label", "原画")
                            .put("mimeType", "application/x-mpegURL")
                            .put(
                                "url",
                                "https://storage.googleapis.com/shaka-demo-assets/angel-one-hls/hls.m3u8",
                            ),
                    )
                    .put("subtitles", JSONArray()),
            )
        }
        val session = JSONObject()
            .put("sessionId", "manual-modern-preview")
            .put("initialResourceId", "preview-1")
            .put("startTimeMs", 0L)
            .put("movie", JSONObject().put("id", "preview").put("title", "Altered Carbon"))
            .put("resources", resources)

        startActivity(
            Intent(this, PlayerActivity::class.java)
                .putExtra(PlayerActivity.EXTRA_SESSION_JSON, session.toString()),
        )
        finish()
    }
}

package com.purewo.cyberstream

import android.app.Activity
import android.content.Intent
import android.os.Bundle
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject

/** Temporary debug-only launcher used for emulator visual verification. */
class PlayerPreviewActivity : Activity() {
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        val resources = JSONArray()
        for (episode in 1..10) {
            resources.put(
                JSONObject()
                    .put("id", "preview-$episode")
                    .put("title", "Altered Carbon · Episode $episode · 2160p HDR")
                    .put("episode", episode.toString())
                    .put("season", 1)
                    .put(
                        "direct",
                        JSONObject()
                            .put("id", "direct")
                            .put("label", "原画")
                            .put("mimeType", "application/x-mpegURL")
                            .put(
                                "url",
                                "https://storage.googleapis.com/shaka-demo-assets/angel-one-hls/hls.m3u8",
                            ),
                    )
                    .put("subtitles", JSONArray()),
            )
        }
        val session = JSONObject()
            .put("sessionId", "manual-layout-preview")
            .put("initialResourceId", "preview-1")
            .put("startTimeMs", 12_000L)
            .put("movie", JSONObject().put("id", "preview").put("title", "Altered Carbon"))
            .put("resources", resources)

        startActivity(
            Intent(this, PlayerActivity::class.java)
                .putExtra(PlayerActivity.EXTRA_SESSION_JSON, session.toString()),
        )
        finish()
    }
}

+    private fun updateVolumeGesture(deltaY: Float) {

<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">

package com.purewo.cyberstream

import android.app.Activity
import android.content.Intent
import android.os.Bundle
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject

/** Temporary debug-only launcher used for emulator visual verification. */
class PlayerPreviewActivity : Activity() {
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        val resources = JSONArray()
        val seasons = JSONArray()
        val episodeCounts = listOf(10, 12, 8)
        episodeCounts.forEachIndexed { seasonIndex, episodeCount ->
            val season = seasonIndex + 1
            val resourceIds = JSONArray()
            for (episode in 1..episodeCount) {
                val id = "preview-s${season}e$episode"
                resourceIds.put(id)
                resources.put(
                    JSONObject()
                        .put("id", id)
                        .put("title", "副本 · 第 ${season} 季第 ${episode} 集")
                        .put("episode", episode.toString())
                        .put(
                            "direct",
                            JSONObject()
                                .put("id", "direct")
                                .put("label", "原画")
                                .put("mimeType", "application/x-mpegURL")
                                .put(
                                    "url",
                                    "https://storage.googleapis.com/shaka-demo-assets/angel-one-hls/hls.m3u8",
                                ),
                        )
                        .put("subtitles", JSONArray()),
                )
            }
            seasons.put(
                JSONObject()
                    .put("season", season)
                    .put("displayTitle", "第 ${season} 季")
                    .put("resourceIds", resourceIds),
            )
        }
        val session = JSONObject()
            .put("sessionId", "manual-season-layout-preview")
            .put("initialResourceId", "preview-s2e4")
            .put("startTimeMs", 12_000L)
            .put(
                "movie",
                JSONObject()
                    .put("id", "preview")
                    .put("title", "副本")
                    .put("seasons", seasons),
            )
            .put("resources", resources)

        startActivity(
            Intent(this, PlayerActivity::class.java)
                .putExtra(PlayerActivity.EXTRA_SESSION_JSON, session.toString()),
        )
        finish()
    }
}

                    .put("resourceIds", resourceIds),
            )
        }
        val session = JSONObject()
            .put("sessionId", "manual-season-layout-preview")
            .put("initialResourceId", "preview-s2e4")
            .put("startTimeMs", 12_000L)
            .put(
                "movie",
                JSONObject()
                    .put("id", "preview")
                    .put("title", "副本")
                    .put("seasons", seasons),
            )
            .put("resources", resources)

        startActivity(
            Intent(this, PlayerActivity::class.java)
                .putExtra(PlayerActivity.EXTRA_SESSION_JSON, session.toString()),
        )
        finish()
    }
}

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<shape xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" android:shape="rectangle">

    <stroke android:width="1dp" android:color="#22FFFFFF" />

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<shape xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" android:shape="rectangle">
    <solid android:color="#FA191C23" />
    <corners
        android:topLeftRadius="28dp"
        android:topRightRadius="28dp" />
</shape>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<FrameLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    android:id="@+id/player_host"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:background="#000000" />

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<vector xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    android:width="24dp"
    android:height="24dp"
    android:viewportWidth="24"
    android:viewportHeight="24">
    <path
        android:fillColor="@android:color/transparent"
        android:pathData="M5,5h14v11H5zM8,19h8M8,9h5M8,12h8"
        android:strokeColor="#FFFFFFFF"
        android:strokeLineCap="round"
        android:strokeLineJoin="round"
        android:strokeWidth="1.8" />
</vector>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<FrameLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:background="#000000">

    <androidx.media3.ui.PlayerView
        android:id="@+id/media_player_view"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="match_parent"
        android:background="#000000"
        android:keepScreenOn="true"
        app:controller_layout_id="@layout/cyber_player_controls"
        app:resize_mode="fit"
        app:show_buffering="when_playing"
        app:show_timeout="3000" />

    <!-- Kept outside PlayerView so ZOOM can crop video without cropping text. -->
    <androidx.media3.ui.SubtitleView
        android:id="@+id/external_subtitle_view"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="match_parent"
        android:clickable="false"
        android:focusable="false"
        android:paddingStart="32dp"
        android:paddingEnd="32dp" />

    <TextView
        android:id="@+id/seek_gesture_overlay"
        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_gravity="center"
        android:background="@drawable/player_seek_gesture_background"
        android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium"
        android:gravity="center"
        android:minWidth="148dp"
        android:paddingStart="20dp"
        android:paddingTop="14dp"
        android:paddingEnd="20dp"
        android:paddingBottom="14dp"
        android:textColor="#FFFFFFFF"
        android:textSize="15sp"
        android:visibility="gone" />

    <LinearLayout
        android:id="@+id/adjustment_gesture_overlay"
        android:layout_width="164dp"
        android:layout_height="72dp"
        android:layout_gravity="center_vertical|start"
        android:layout_marginStart="28dp"
        android:background="@drawable/player_seek_gesture_background"
        android:gravity="center_vertical"
        android:orientation="vertical"
        android:paddingStart="16dp"
        android:paddingTop="12dp"
        android:paddingEnd="16dp"
        android:paddingBottom="12dp"
        android:visibility="gone">

        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="0dp"
            android:layout_weight="1"
            android:gravity="center_vertical"
            android:orientation="horizontal">

            <ImageView
                android:id="@+id/adjustment_gesture_icon"
                android:layout_width="22dp"
                android:layout_height="22dp"
                android:contentDescription="亮度"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_player_brightness"
                android:tint="#FF5BE7FF" />

            <TextView
                android:id="@+id/adjustment_gesture_label"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_marginStart="10dp"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium"
                android:includeFontPadding="false"
                android:textColor="#FFFFFFFF"
                android:textSize="14sp" />
        </LinearLayout>

        <ProgressBar
            android:id="@+id/adjustment_gesture_progress"
            style="?android:attr/progressBarStyleHorizontal"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="4dp"
            android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
            android:indeterminate="false"
            android:max="100"
            android:progressBackgroundTint="#35FFFFFF"
            android:progressTint="#FF5BE7FF" />
    </LinearLayout>

    <View
        android:id="@+id/side_panel_scrim"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="match_parent"
        android:background="#66000000"
        android:clickable="true"
        android:focusable="true"
        android:visibility="gone" />

    <LinearLayout
        android:id="@+id/side_panel"
        android:layout_width="@dimen/player_side_panel_width"
        android:layout_height="match_parent"
        android:layout_gravity="end"
        android:background="@drawable/player_side_panel_background"

        android:elevation="24dp"
        android:focusable="true"

                android:layout_height="44dp"

            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="1dp"
            android:layout_marginTop="6dp"

            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="0dp"
            android:layout_weight="1"
            android:clipToPadding="false"
            android:fillViewport="true"
            android:overScrollMode="never"
            android:paddingBottom="12dp">

            <LinearLayout
                android:id="@+id/side_panel_items"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:orientation="vertical" />

</FrameLayout>

                android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium"
                android:includeFontPadding="false"
                android:minWidth="0dp"
                android:paddingStart="12dp"
                android:paddingEnd="12dp"
                android:stateListAnimator="@null"

                android:textColor="#F2FFFFFF"

                android:layout_marginStart="6dp"

                android:paddingStart="12dp"
                android:paddingEnd="12dp"

                android:src="@drawable/ic_player_settings"
                android:tint="#F2FFFFFF" />

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/orientation_button"
                android:layout_width="46dp"
                android:layout_height="46dp"
                android:layout_marginStart="6dp"
                android:background="@drawable/player_quality_chip"
                android:contentDescription="退出全屏"
                android:padding="10dp"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_player_portrait"
                android:tint="#FF5BE7FF" />
        </LinearLayout>
    </LinearLayout>
</merge>

<FrameLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto"

    android:layout_height="match_parent"

        android:layout_height="match_parent"
        android:orientation="vertical">

            android:layout_width="match_parent"

                android:keepScreenOn="true"
                app:controller_layout_id="@layout/cyber_player_controls"
                app:resize_mode="fit"
                app:show_buffering="when_playing"
                app:show_timeout="3000" />

            <androidx.media3.ui.SubtitleView
                android:id="@+id/external_subtitle_view"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:clickable="false"
                android:focusable="false"
                android:paddingStart="18dp"
                android:paddingEnd="18dp" />

            <TextView
                android:id="@+id/seek_gesture_overlay"
                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_gravity="center"
                android:background="@drawable/player_seek_gesture_background"
                android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium"
                android:gravity="center"
                android:minWidth="132dp"
                android:paddingStart="16dp"
                android:paddingTop="11dp"
                android:paddingEnd="16dp"
                android:paddingBottom="11dp"
                android:textColor="#FFFFFFFF"
                android:textSize="13sp"
                android:visibility="gone" />

            <LinearLayout
                android:id="@+id/adjustment_gesture_overlay"
                android:layout_width="142dp"
                android:layout_height="62dp"
                android:layout_gravity="center_vertical|start"
                android:layout_marginStart="12dp"
                android:background="@drawable/player_seek_gesture_background"
                android:gravity="center_vertical"
                android:orientation="vertical"
                android:paddingStart="13dp"
                android:paddingTop="9dp"
                android:paddingEnd="13dp"
                android:paddingBottom="9dp"
                android:visibility="gone">

                <LinearLayout
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="0dp"
                    android:layout_weight="1"
                    android:gravity="center_vertical"
                    android:orientation="horizontal">

                    <ImageView
                        android:id="@+id/adjustment_gesture_icon"
                        android:layout_width="19dp"
                        android:layout_height="19dp"
                        android:contentDescription="亮度"
                        android:src="@drawable/ic_player_brightness"
                        android:tint="#FF5BE7FF" />

                    <TextView
                        android:id="@+id/adjustment_gesture_label"
                        android:layout_width="0dp"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_marginStart="8dp"
                        android:layout_weight="1"
                        android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium"
                        android:includeFontPadding="false"
                        android:textColor="#FFFFFFFF"
                        android:textSize="12sp" />
                </LinearLayout>

                <ProgressBar
                    android:id="@+id/adjustment_gesture_progress"
                    style="?android:attr/progressBarStyleHorizontal"
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="3dp"
                    android:layout_marginTop="6dp"
                    android:indeterminate="false"
                    android:max="100"
                    android:progressBackgroundTint="#35FFFFFF"
                    android:progressTint="#FF5BE7FF" />
            </LinearLayout>
        </FrameLayout>

        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="58dp"
            android:background="#FF11151C"
            android:gravity="center"
            android:orientation="horizontal"
            android:paddingStart="8dp"
            android:paddingEnd="8dp">

            <Button
                android:id="@+id/quality_button"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="42dp"
                android:layout_margin="3dp"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:background="@drawable/player_quality_chip"
                android:backgroundTint="@null"
                android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium"
                android:includeFontPadding="false"
                android:minWidth="0dp"
                android:paddingStart="3dp"
                android:paddingEnd="3dp"
                android:stateListAnimator="@null"
                android:text="画质"
                android:textAllCaps="false"
                android:textColor="#FF5BE7FF"
                android:textSize="12sp"
                android:visibility="gone" />

            <Button
                android:id="@+id/subtitle_button"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="42dp"
                android:layout_margin="3dp"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:background="@drawable/player_control_chip"
                android:backgroundTint="@null"
                android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium"
                android:includeFontPadding="false"
                android:minWidth="0dp"
                android:paddingStart="3dp"
                android:paddingEnd="3dp"
                android:stateListAnimator="@null"
                android:text="字幕"
                android:textAllCaps="false"
                android:textColor="#F2FFFFFF"
                android:textSize="12sp" />

            <Button
                android:id="@+id/audio_button"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="42dp"
                android:layout_margin="3dp"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:background="@drawable/player_control_chip"
                android:backgroundTint="@null"
                android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium"
                android:includeFontPadding="false"
                android:minWidth="0dp"
                android:paddingStart="3dp"
                android:paddingEnd="3dp"
                android:stateListAnimator="@null"
                android:text="音轨"
                android:textAllCaps="false"
                android:textColor="#F2FFFFFF"
                android:textSize="12sp" />

            <Button
                android:id="@+id/settings_button"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="42dp"
                android:layout_margin="3dp"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:background="@drawable/player_control_chip"
                android:backgroundTint="@null"
                android:drawableStart="@drawable/ic_player_settings"
                android:drawablePadding="3dp"
                android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium"
                android:includeFontPadding="false"
                android:minWidth="0dp"
                android:paddingStart="4dp"
                android:paddingEnd="4dp"
                android:stateListAnimator="@null"
                android:text="设置"
                android:textAllCaps="false"
                android:textColor="#F2FFFFFF"
                android:textSize="12sp" />

            <Button
                android:id="@+id/orientation_button"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="42dp"
                android:layout_margin="3dp"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:background="@drawable/player_quality_chip"
                android:backgroundTint="@null"
                android:drawableStart="@drawable/ic_player_landscape"
                android:drawablePadding="3dp"
                android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium"
                android:includeFontPadding="false"
                android:minWidth="0dp"
                android:paddingStart="4dp"
                android:paddingEnd="4dp"
                android:stateListAnimator="@null"
                android:text="全屏"
                android:textAllCaps="false"
                android:textColor="#FF5BE7FF"
                android:textSize="12sp" />

            <Button
                android:id="@+id/source_button"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="0dp"
                android:visibility="gone" />
        </LinearLayout>

        <FrameLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="0dp"
            android:layout_weight="1"
            android:background="#FF0B0E13">

            <LinearLayout
                android:id="@+id/portrait_episode_section"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:orientation="vertical"
                android:paddingStart="16dp"
                android:paddingTop="15dp"
                android:paddingEnd="16dp"
                android:paddingBottom="12dp">

                <LinearLayout
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="40dp"
                    android:gravity="center_vertical"
                    android:orientation="horizontal">

                    <TextView
                        android:layout_width="0dp"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_weight="1"
                        android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium"
                        android:text="选集"
                        android:textColor="#FFFFFFFF"
                        android:textSize="20sp" />

                    <TextView
                        android:id="@+id/portrait_episode_summary"
                        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:textColor="#8FFFFFFF"
                        android:textSize="13sp" />
                </LinearLayout>

                <HorizontalScrollView
                    android:id="@+id/portrait_season_scroll"
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="44dp"
                    android:clipToPadding="false"
                    android:fillViewport="false"
                    android:overScrollMode="never"
                    android:scrollbars="none"
                    android:visibility="gone">

                    <LinearLayout
                        android:id="@+id/portrait_season_tabs"
                        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_height="match_parent"
                        android:gravity="center_vertical"
                        android:orientation="horizontal" />
                </HorizontalScrollView>

                <ScrollView
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="0dp"
                    android:layout_weight="1"
                    android:clipToPadding="false"
                    android:fillViewport="true"
                    android:overScrollMode="never"
                    android:paddingTop="8dp">

                    <GridLayout
                        android:id="@+id/portrait_episode_grid"
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:alignmentMode="alignMargins"
                        android:columnCount="5"
                        android:orientation="horizontal"
                        android:useDefaultMargins="false" />
                </ScrollView>
            </LinearLayout>

            <ScrollView
                android:id="@+id/portrait_movie_section"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:clipToPadding="false"
                android:fillViewport="true"
                android:overScrollMode="never"
                android:paddingStart="16dp"
                android:paddingTop="16dp"
                android:paddingEnd="16dp"
                android:paddingBottom="24dp"
                android:visibility="gone">

                <LinearLayout
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:orientation="vertical">

                    <TextView
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium"
                        android:text="当前片源"
                        android:textColor="#FFFFFFFF"
                        android:textSize="20sp" />

                    <HorizontalScrollView
                        android:id="@+id/portrait_movie_sources_scroll"
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="52dp"
                        android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
                        android:clipToPadding="false"
                        android:overScrollMode="never"
                        android:scrollbars="none">

                        <LinearLayout
                            android:id="@+id/portrait_movie_sources"
                            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                            android:layout_height="match_parent"
                            android:gravity="center_vertical"
                            android:orientation="horizontal" />
                    </HorizontalScrollView>

                    <LinearLayout
                        android:id="@+id/portrait_movie_technical"
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
                        android:orientation="vertical" />
                </LinearLayout>
            </ScrollView>
        </FrameLayout>
    </LinearLayout>

    <View
        android:id="@+id/side_panel_scrim"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="match_parent"
        android:background="#7A000000"
        android:clickable="true"
        android:focusable="true"
        android:visibility="gone" />

    <LinearLayout
        android:id="@+id/side_panel"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="match_parent"
        android:layout_gravity="bottom"
        android:layout_marginTop="112dp"
        android:background="@drawable/player_bottom_sheet_background"
        android:clickable="true"
        android:elevation="24dp"
        android:focusable="true"
        android:orientation="vertical"
        android:paddingStart="22dp"
        android:paddingTop="16dp"
        android:paddingEnd="18dp"
        android:paddingBottom="18dp"
        android:visibility="gone">

        <View
            android:layout_width="42dp"
            android:layout_height="4dp"
            android:layout_gravity="center_horizontal"
            android:layout_marginBottom="8dp"
            android:background="#38FFFFFF" />

        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="50dp"
            android:gravity="center_vertical"
            android:orientation="horizontal">

            <TextView
                android:id="@+id/side_panel_title"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:ellipsize="end"
                android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium"
                android:maxLines="1"
                android:textColor="#FFFFFFFF"
                android:textSize="20sp" />

            <ImageButton
                android:id="@+id/side_panel_close"
                android:layout_width="44dp"
                android:layout_height="44dp"
                android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
                android:contentDescription="关闭面板"
                android:padding="11dp"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_player_close"
                android:tint="#D9FFFFFF" />
        </LinearLayout>

        <View
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="1dp"
            android:layout_marginTop="5dp"
            android:layout_marginBottom="11dp"
            android:background="#1FFFFFFF" />

        <ScrollView
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="0dp"
            android:layout_weight="1"
            android:clipToPadding="false"
            android:fillViewport="true"
            android:overScrollMode="never">

            <LinearLayout
                android:id="@+id/side_panel_items"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:orientation="vertical" />
        </ScrollView>
    </LinearLayout>
</FrameLayout>

+    private fun fetchCloudQualities(resource: JSONObject, cloud: JSONObject): List<CloudQuality> {
+        val endpoint = cloud.optString("qualitiesUrl").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
+            ?: return emptyList()
+        val connection = (URL(endpoint).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection).apply {
+            connectTimeout = 12_000
+            readTimeout = 15_000
+            instanceFollowRedirects = true
+            requestMethod = "GET"
+            setRequestProperty("Accept", "application/json")
+            resource.optJSONObject("direct")?.optString("userAgent")
+                ?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
+                ?.let { setRequestProperty("User-Agent", it) }
+        }
+        try {
+            val responseCode = connection.responseCode
+            if (responseCode == 401) throw PlaybackAuthException()
+            if (responseCode !in 200..299) error("HTTP $responseCode")
+            val body = connection.inputStream.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8).use { it.readText() }
+            val root = JSONObject(body)
+            val data = root.optJSONObject("data") ?: root
+            val defaultResolution = data.optString("default_resolution")
+            val items = data.optJSONArray("items") ?: JSONArray()
+            val streamUrl = cloud.optString("streamUrl")
+            val resolutionParam = cloud.optString("resolutionParam", "resolution")
+            return (0 until items.length()).mapNotNull { index ->
+                val item = items.optJSONObject(index) ?: return@mapNotNull null
+                if (!item.optBoolean("available", false)) return@mapNotNull null
+                val resolution = item.optString("resolution").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
+                    ?: return@mapNotNull null
+                val url = Uri.parse(streamUrl).buildUpon()
+                    .appendQueryParameter(resolutionParam, resolution)
+                    .build()
+                    .toString()
+                val label = item.optString("label").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: resolution.uppercase(Locale.ROOT)
+                CloudQuality(
+                    resolution = resolution,
+                    label = label,
+                    url = url,
+                    rank = item.optInt("rank", index),
+                    format = item.optString("format").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
+                    width = item.optInt("width", 0).takeIf { it > 0 },
+                    height = item.optInt("height", 0).takeIf { it > 0 },
+                    bitrate = item.optLong("bitrate", 0L).takeIf { it > 0 },
+                    isDefault = resolution == defaultResolution,
+                )
+            }.sortedByDescending { it.rank }
+        } finally {
+            connection.disconnect()
+        }
+    }

+        val units = arrayOf("KB", "MB", "GB", "TB")
+        var value = bytes.toDouble()
+        var unit = -1
+        do {
+            value /= 1024.0
+            unit += 1
+        } while (value >= 1024.0 && unit < units.lastIndex)
+        return String.format(Locale.US, if (value >= 100) "%.0f %s" else "%.2f %s", value, units[unit])
+    }

<FrameLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    android:id="@+id/cellular_warning_root"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:background="#FF080808"
    android:clickable="true"
    android:focusable="true"
    android:keepScreenOn="true">

    <ScrollView
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="match_parent"
        android:clipToPadding="false"
        android:fillViewport="true"
        android:overScrollMode="never"
        android:scrollbars="none">

        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:gravity="center"
            android:orientation="vertical"
            android:paddingStart="24dp"
            android:paddingTop="@dimen/cellular_warning_content_vertical_padding"
            android:paddingEnd="24dp"
            android:paddingBottom="@dimen/cellular_warning_content_vertical_padding">

            <ImageView
                android:id="@+id/cellular_warning_backdrop"
                android:layout_width="@dimen/cellular_warning_art_width"

                android:contentDescription="影片背景海报"
                android:scaleType="centerCrop" />

            <TextView
                android:id="@+id/cellular_warning_title"
                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_marginTop="10dp"
                android:ellipsize="end"
                android:fontFamily="sans-serif"
                android:includeFontPadding="false"
                android:maxLines="1"
                android:textColor="#B8FFFFFF"
                android:textSize="18sp" />

            <TextView
                android:id="@+id/cellular_warning_message"
                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_marginTop="12dp"
                android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium"
                android:gravity="center"
                android:includeFontPadding="false"
                android:maxLines="2"
                android:textColor="#FFFFFFFF"
                android:textSize="17sp" />

            <LinearLayout
                android:layout_width="@dimen/cellular_warning_actions_width"
                android:layout_height="@dimen/cellular_warning_button_height"
                android:layout_marginTop="16dp"
                android:orientation="horizontal">

                <Button
                    android:id="@+id/cellular_warning_allow_once"
                    android:layout_width="0dp"
                    android:layout_height="match_parent"
                    android:layout_marginEnd="8dp"
                    android:layout_weight="1"
                    android:background="@drawable/player_cellular_warning_once"
                    android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium"
                    android:minHeight="0dp"
                    android:minWidth="0dp"
                    android:stateListAnimator="@null"
                    android:text="本次允许"
                    android:textAllCaps="false"
                    android:textColor="#FFFFFFFF"
                    android:textSize="18sp" />

                <Button
                    android:id="@+id/cellular_warning_allow_always"
                    android:layout_width="0dp"
                    android:layout_height="match_parent"
                    android:layout_marginStart="8dp"
                    android:layout_weight="1"
                    android:background="@drawable/player_cellular_warning_always"
                    android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium"
                    android:minHeight="0dp"
                    android:minWidth="0dp"
                    android:stateListAnimator="@null"
                    android:text="始终允许"
                    android:textAllCaps="false"
                    android:textColor="#FF090909"
                    android:textSize="18sp" />
            </LinearLayout>
        </LinearLayout>
    </ScrollView>

    <Button
        android:id="@+id/cellular_warning_exit"
        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
        android:layout_height="@dimen/cellular_warning_exit_height"
        android:layout_gravity="top|end"
        android:layout_marginTop="22dp"
        android:layout_marginEnd="26dp"

        android:drawableStart="@drawable/ic_player_close"

        android:minHeight="0dp"

        android:stateListAnimator="@null"
        android:text="退出播放"
        android:textAllCaps="false"
        android:textColor="#FFFFFFFF"
        android:textSize="17sp" />
</FrameLayout>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:layout_marginBottom="12dp"
    android:background="@drawable/player_panel_item_background"
    android:orientation="vertical"
    android:paddingStart="16dp"
    android:paddingTop="15dp"
    android:paddingEnd="16dp"
    android:paddingBottom="15dp">

    <TextView
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium"
        android:text="在线字幕库"
        android:textColor="#FFFFFFFF"
        android:textSize="16sp" />

    <TextView
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_marginTop="4dp"
        android:text="按当前影片或季集搜索，选择后会下载并立即应用到本机播放。"
        android:textColor="#8FFFFFFF"
        android:textSize="12sp" />

    <LinearLayout
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_marginTop="13dp"
        android:gravity="center_vertical"
        android:orientation="horizontal">

        <EditText
            android:id="@+id/online_subtitle_query"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="48dp"
            android:layout_weight="1"
            android:background="@drawable/player_online_subtitle_input"
            android:fontFamily="sans-serif"
            android:hint="影片名 / S01E01"
            android:imeOptions="actionSearch"
            android:includeFontPadding="false"
            android:inputType="text"
            android:maxLines="1"
            android:singleLine="true"
            android:textColor="#FFFFFFFF"
            android:textColorHint="#66FFFFFF"
            android:textSize="14sp" />

        <Button
            android:id="@+id/online_subtitle_search"
            android:layout_width="82dp"
            android:layout_height="46dp"
            android:layout_marginStart="9dp"
            android:background="@drawable/player_quality_chip"
            android:backgroundTint="@null"
            android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium"
            android:includeFontPadding="false"
            android:minWidth="0dp"
            android:stateListAnimator="@null"
            android:text="搜索"
            android:textAllCaps="false"
            android:textColor="#FF5BE7FF"
            android:textSize="14sp" />
    </LinearLayout>

    <LinearLayout
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_marginTop="11dp"
        android:gravity="center_vertical"
        android:orientation="horizontal">

        <ProgressBar
            android:id="@+id/online_subtitle_progress"
            style="?android:attr/progressBarStyleSmall"
            android:layout_width="18dp"
            android:layout_height="18dp"
            android:indeterminateTint="#FF5BE7FF"
            android:visibility="gone" />

        <TextView
            android:id="@+id/online_subtitle_status"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginStart="8dp"
            android:layout_weight="1"
            android:ellipsize="end"
            android:maxLines="2"
            android:text="SubHD · SrtKu"
            android:textColor="#9FFFFFFF"
            android:textSize="12sp" />
    </LinearLayout>
</LinearLayout>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<selector xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">
    <item android:state_focused="true">
        <shape android:shape="rectangle">
            <solid android:color="#161C2530" />
            <stroke android:width="1dp" android:color="#B35BE7FF" />
            <corners android:radius="12dp" />
            <padding
                android:left="14dp"
                android:top="10dp"
                android:right="14dp"
                android:bottom="10dp" />
        </shape>
    </item>
    <item>
        <shape android:shape="rectangle">
            <solid android:color="#12182022" />
            <stroke android:width="1dp" android:color="#24FFFFFF" />
            <corners android:radius="12dp" />
            <padding
                android:left="14dp"
                android:top="10dp"
                android:right="14dp"
                android:bottom="10dp" />
        </shape>
    </item>
</selector>

+
+    private fun performOnlineSubtitleSearch(
+        config: JSONObject,
+        resourceId: String,
+        keyword: String,
+        header: View,
+        searchButton: Button,
+        progress: ProgressBar,
+        status: TextView,
+    ) {
+        if (resourceId.isBlank() || onlineSubtitleBinding) return
+        val searchEndpoint = config.optString("searchUrl")
+        if (searchEndpoint.isBlank()) {
+            status.text = "在线字幕搜索地址不可用"
+            return
+        }
+        val requestId = ++onlineSubtitleRequestId
+        removePanelViewsAfter(header)
+        searchButton.isEnabled = false
+        progress.visibility = View.VISIBLE
+        status.text = "正在搜索 SubHD 与 SrtKu…"
+
+        val builder = Uri.parse(searchEndpoint).buildUpon()
+        if (keyword.isNotBlank()) builder.appendQueryParameter("keyword", keyword)
+        val providers = config.optJSONArray("providers")?.toStringList()?.joinToString(",")
+        if (!providers.isNullOrBlank()) builder.appendQueryParameter("providers", providers)
+        val searchUrl = builder.build().toString()
+
+        networkExecutor.execute {
+            val result = requestJson(searchUrl)
+            handler.post {
+                if (
+                    didFinish || requestId != onlineSubtitleRequestId ||
+                    activePanelKind != "online_subtitles" ||
+                    currentResource?.optString("id") != resourceId
+                ) {
+                    return@post
+                }
+                searchButton.isEnabled = true
+                progress.visibility = View.GONE
+                if (!result.successful) {
+                    status.text = when (result.status) {
+                        401 -> "播放授权已过期，请退出播放器后重新进入"
+                        429 -> "字幕源正忙，请稍后重试"
+                        else -> result.message ?: "在线字幕搜索失败"
+                    }
+                    addPanelMessage("没有取得字幕候选", status.text.toString())
+                    return@post
+                }
+                val data = result.body?.optJSONObject("data") ?: result.body ?: JSONObject()
+                val candidates = data.optJSONArray("items") ?: JSONArray()
+                val providerNotice = onlineSubtitleProviderNotice(data.optJSONObject("providers"))
+                status.text = if (candidates.length() > 0) {
+                    "找到 ${candidates.length()} 条候选${providerNotice?.let { " · $it" }.orEmpty()}"
+                } else {
+                    "没有匹配结果${providerNotice?.let { " · $it" }.orEmpty()}"
+                }
+                if (candidates.length() == 0) {
+                    addPanelMessage("未找到在线字幕", "可以修改影片名、英文名或季集编号后重试")
+                    return@post
+                }
+                for (index in 0 until candidates.length()) {
+                    val candidate = candidates.optJSONObject(index) ?: continue
+                    addOnlineSubtitleCandidate(
+                        config = config,
+                        resourceId = resourceId,
+                        keyword = keyword,
+                        candidate = candidate,
+                        progress = progress,
+                        status = status,
+                    )
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun addOnlineSubtitleCandidate(
+        config: JSONObject,
+        resourceId: String,
+        keyword: String,
+        candidate: JSONObject,
+        progress: ProgressBar,
+        status: TextView,
+    ) {
+        val candidateId = candidate.optString("candidate_id")
+            .ifBlank { candidate.optString("id") }
+        if (candidateId.isBlank()) return
+        val normalizedFormat = candidate.optString("format_normalized")
+            .ifBlank { candidate.optString("format") }
+            .lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
+        val bitmapSubtitle = normalizedFormat in setOf("sub", "sup", "pgs")
+        val provider = candidate.optString("provider_name")
+            .ifBlank { candidate.optString("provider_id") }

+
+    private fun bindOnlineSubtitle(
+        config: JSONObject,
+        resourceId: String,
+        keyword: String,
+        candidate: JSONObject,
+        progress: ProgressBar,
+        status: TextView,
+    ) {
+        if (onlineSubtitleBinding) return
+        val candidateId = candidate.optString("candidate_id")
+            .ifBlank { candidate.optString("id") }
+        val bindUrl = config.optString("bindUrl")
+        if (candidateId.isBlank() || bindUrl.isBlank()) return
+        val downloadIndex = candidate.optJSONArray("downloads")
+            ?.optJSONObject(0)
+            ?.optInt("download_index", 0)
+            ?: 0
+        val payload = JSONObject()
+            .put("candidate_id", candidateId)
+            .put("download_index", downloadIndex)
+            .put("confirm", true)
+        val requestId = ++onlineSubtitleRequestId
+        onlineSubtitleBinding = true
+        progress.visibility = View.VISIBLE
+        status.text = "正在下载并绑定字幕…"
+
+        networkExecutor.execute {
+            val result = requestJson(bindUrl, "POST", payload)
+            handler.post {
+                onlineSubtitleBinding = false
+                if (
+                    didFinish || requestId != onlineSubtitleRequestId ||
+                    currentResource?.optString("id") != resourceId
+                ) {
+                    return@post
+                }
+                progress.visibility = View.GONE
+                if (!result.successful) {
+                    status.text = when (result.status) {
+                        401 -> "播放授权已过期，请退出播放器后重新进入"
+                        409 -> "该字幕已经绑定，可返回字幕列表选择"
+                        413 -> "字幕压缩包过大，已停止下载"
+                        502 -> result.message ?: "字幕源下载失败，请换一个候选"
+                        else -> result.message ?: "字幕绑定失败"
+                    }
+                    return@post
+                }
+                val data = result.body?.optJSONObject("data") ?: result.body ?: JSONObject()
+                val selectedSubtitleId = data.optJSONObject("subtitle")?.optString("id").orEmpty()
+                val rawItems = data.optJSONObject("subtitles")?.optJSONArray("items")
+                    ?: data.optJSONObject("playback")
+                        ?.optJSONObject("subtitles")
+                        ?.optJSONArray("items")
+                if (rawItems == null || rawItems.length() == 0) {
+                    status.text = "字幕已绑定，但播放器没有收到可加载地址"
+                    return@post
+                }
+                val normalized = normalizeBoundSubtitles(
+                    rawItems = rawItems,
+                    config = config,
+                    selectedSubtitleId = selectedSubtitleId,
+                )
+                if (normalized.length() == 0) {
+                    status.text = "字幕格式暂不受 Android 播放器支持"
+                    return@post
+                }
+                val resource = currentResource ?: return@post
+                resource.put("subtitles", normalized)
+                rawSessionJson = session.toString()
+                val position = player.currentPosition.coerceAtLeast(0L)
+                val shouldPlay = player.playWhenReady
+                loadResource(resource, position, shouldPlay = shouldPlay, resetTrackSelection = true)
+                Toast.makeText(this, "在线字幕已下载并应用", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
+                closeSidePanel()
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun normalizeBoundSubtitles(
+        rawItems: JSONArray,
+        config: JSONObject,
+        selectedSubtitleId: String,
+    ): JSONArray {
+        val normalized = JSONArray()
+        for (index in 0 until rawItems.length()) {
+            val raw = rawItems.optJSONObject(index) ?: continue
+            val id = raw.optString("id")
+            if (id.isBlank()) continue
+            val webPlayer = raw.optJSONObject("web_player")
+            val format = webPlayer?.optString("format")?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
+                ?: raw.optString("format")
+            if (format.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) in setOf("sub", "sup", "pgs")) continue
+            val sourceUrl = webPlayer?.optString("url")?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
+                ?: raw.optString("url")
+            if (sourceUrl.isBlank()) continue
+            val native = JSONObject()
+                .put("id", id)
+                .put(
+                    "label",
+                    raw.optString("display_name")
+                        .ifBlank { raw.optString("label") }
+                        .ifBlank { raw.optString("filename") }
+                        .ifBlank { "在线字幕" },
+                )
+                .put("format", format.lowercase(Locale.ROOT))
+                .put(
+                    "mimeType",
+                    webPlayer?.optString("mime_type")?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
+                        ?: raw.optString("mime_type"),
+                )
+                .put("url", resolveOnlineSubtitleUrl(config, sourceUrl))
+                .put("isDefault", id == selectedSubtitleId || raw.optBoolean("is_default", false))
+                .put("isForced", raw.optBoolean("is_forced", false))
+                .put("supported", webPlayer?.optBoolean("supported", true) != false)
+            subtitleLanguageLabel(raw.opt("language"))?.let { native.put("language", it) }
+            normalized.put(native)
+        }
+        return normalized
+    }
+
+    private fun resolveOnlineSubtitleUrl(config: JSONObject, value: String): String {
+        val apiBase = config.optString("apiBaseUrl").trimEnd('/')
+        val resolved = when {
+            value.startsWith("http://") || value.startsWith("https://") -> value
+            value.startsWith("/api/") -> {
+                val origin = runCatching {
+                    val parsed = URL(apiBase)
+                    "${parsed.protocol}://${parsed.authority}"
+                }.getOrDefault(apiBase.removeSuffix("/api"))
+                "$origin$value"
+            }
+            value.startsWith("/v1/") -> "$apiBase$value"
+            value.startsWith("/") -> {
+                val origin = runCatching {
+                    val parsed = URL(apiBase)
+                    "${parsed.protocol}://${parsed.authority}"
+                }.getOrDefault(apiBase.removeSuffix("/api"))
+                "$origin$value"
+            }
+            else -> "$apiBase/$value"
+        }
+        val ticket = Uri.parse(config.optString("bindUrl")).getQueryParameter("ticket")
+        if (ticket.isNullOrBlank() || Uri.parse(resolved).getQueryParameter("ticket") != null) {
+            return resolved
+        }
+        return Uri.parse(resolved).buildUpon().appendQueryParameter("ticket", ticket).build().toString()
+    }
+
+    private fun subtitleLanguageLabel(value: Any?): String? = when (value) {
+        is String -> value.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
+        is JSONObject -> listOf("label", "name", "code")
+            .firstNotNullOfOrNull { key -> value.optString(key).takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } }
+        is JSONArray -> value.toStringList().joinToString(" / ").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
+        else -> null
+    }
+
+    private fun JSONArray.toStringList(): List<String> = (0 until length()).mapNotNull { index ->
+        optString(index).takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
+    }
+
+    private fun removePanelViewsAfter(header: View) {
+        val headerIndex = sidePanelItems.indexOfChild(header)
+        while (headerIndex >= 0 && sidePanelItems.childCount > headerIndex + 1) {
+            sidePanelItems.removeViewAt(headerIndex + 1)
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun onlineSubtitleProviderNotice(providers: JSONObject?): String? {
+        if (providers == null) return null
+        val used = providers.optJSONArray("used")?.toStringList()?.joinToString("+")
+        val errors = providers.optJSONArray("errors")
+        val errorText = if (errors == null || errors.length() == 0) null else {
+            (0 until errors.length()).mapNotNull { index ->
+                val error = errors.optJSONObject(index) ?: return@mapNotNull null
+                val provider = error.optString("provider_id").ifBlank { "字幕源" }
+                val reason = error.optString("reason").ifBlank { "不可用" }
+                "$provider $reason"
+            }.joinToString("、").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
+        }
+        return listOfNotNull(used?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }, errorText).joinToString(" · ").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
+    }
+
+    private fun requestJson(
+        endpoint: String,
+        method: String = "GET",
+        payload: JSONObject? = null,
+    ): HttpJsonResult {
+        var connection: HttpURLConnection? = null
+        return try {
+            connection = (URL(endpoint).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection).apply {
+                requestMethod = method
+                instanceFollowRedirects = true
+                connectTimeout = 15_000
+                readTimeout = 60_000
+                setRequestProperty("Accept", "application/json")
+                if (payload != null) {
+                    doOutput = true
+                    setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
+                }
+            }
+            if (payload != null) {
+                connection.outputStream.use { output ->
+                    output.write(payload.toString().toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
+                }
+            }
+            val status = connection.responseCode
+            val stream = if (status in 200..299) connection.inputStream else connection.errorStream
+            val text = stream?.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8)?.use { it.readText() }.orEmpty()
+            val body = text.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let { runCatching { JSONObject(it) }.getOrNull() }
+            HttpJsonResult(
+                status = status,
+                body = body,
+                message = body?.optString("msg")?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
+                    ?: body?.optString("message")?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
+                    ?: if (status in 200..299) null else "HTTP $status",
+            )
+        } catch (error: Exception) {
+            Log.w(LOG_TAG, "Online subtitle request failed: $endpoint", error)
+            HttpJsonResult(0, null, error.message ?: "网络连接失败")
+        } finally {
+            connection?.disconnect()
+        }
+    }

<LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:layout_marginBottom="7dp"
    android:background="@drawable/player_panel_item_background"
    android:clickable="true"
    android:focusable="true"
    android:minHeight="118dp"

        <Button

            android:textSize="13sp" />

            android:text="绑定"

            android:textSize="13sp" />
    </LinearLayout>
</LinearLayout>
